question: Why is consciousness not wholly ignorance when it is described as devoid of knowledge?
premises: Consciousness is described as devoid of knowledge
inference: Even when lacking knowledge, consciousness is not to be equated entirely with ignorance.
uncertainties: The syntax of sa cetā ajñāna na sarvaḥ is archaic and compressed.
plain_english: That conscious one is not entirely ignorance; consciousness is devoid of knowledge.
